description: Stay connected throughout the day, with fewer check-ins. See whether your children have reached school or your family has arrived home. iSharing has provided location-sharing services since 2010. FREE BASIC FEATURES: ★ Real-Time GPS Location Tracker: Share live locations privately and check updates on the map. Choose to share your location with consent. Use iSharing as a family tracker to check where your children are during the school run or a daily journey. GPS tracking brings location updates together on one map, so you can check progress without sending a separate message each time. ★ Place Alerts: Receive notifications when family members arrive at or leave places such as home, school or work, without repeated 'Where are you?' messages. Set place alerts for regular destinations and receive an update when an arrival or departure is detected. Location sharing is useful for checking that a journey has ended, while notifications help you stay informed when you are not looking at the map. ★ Meetup - Temporary Location Sharing: Share live locations in a group for a set time without adding permanent connections. Join via a link or QR code and use group chat. Location sharing ends automatically at the scheduled time. Use Meetup for a group outing or trip when you only need live location sharing for a limited period. Share the joining link or QR code, check the group on the map and coordinate through group chat until sharing ends. ★ Find My Phone & Phone Tracker: Help locate a lost or stolen phone using its available location on the map. The phone tracker can help you check the available location of a phone that has been misplaced. Location availability depends on the device, its connection and the required location permissions; entering a phone number alone does not locate a device. ★ SOS Alert: Send an emergency notification and your current location to your family with a single tap. Your SOS notification includes your current location, giving your family more context when you ask for help. Voice messages offer another way to communicate without typing a long message while travelling. ★ Walkie-Talkie: Send voice messages directly through iSharing for convenient communication on the go. ★ Location History: Review previous locations and routes to understand daily journeys. Location history lets you look back at previous locations and routes, rather than checking only the current position. Review everyday journeys or use the record to help remember where a phone was taken. PREMIUM FEATURES: 🔄 Location history for up to 365 days 📍 Unlimited place alerts 📡 3D Street View 🔋 Low battery alerts 🚗 Driving alerts and reports covering speeding, harsh braking and phone use 🆘 SOS sound recording 👵 Inactivity alerts 💻 Linked devices and web app 🛑 Remove ads With Premium, extend your review to up to 365 days of location history and add alerts for more places. Driving reports provide details about trips and recorded driving events, while battery and inactivity alerts add context beyond the live map. Basic location sharing is free. Try Premium free for 7 days; a paid subscription is required after the trial to continue using Premium features. iSharing uses a foreground service to update location in the background and provide timely location updates. Need help? Contact contact@isharingsoft.com. * iSharing is designed for mutual location sharing and should only be used with consent.
summary: Share live GPS location, get arrival alerts and help find your lost phone.
title: iSharing: GPS Location Tracker
